take_source() {
  if test "$seen_source" = yes; then bad_options; fi
  if test -z "$1"; then bad_options; fi
  source=$1
  seen_source=yes
}
take_output() {
  if test "$seen_output" = yes; then bad_options; fi
  if test -z "$1"; then bad_options; fi
  output=$1
  seen_output=yes
}
valid_name() {
  case "$1" in
    *'
'*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Eq -- '^[a-z][a-z0-9._= -]{0,15}$'
}
seen_source=no
seen_output=no
source=''
output=''
count=no
while test "$#" -gt 0; do
  case "$1" in
    --source=*) take_source "${1#--source=}"; shift ;;
    --output=*) take_output "${1#--output=}"; shift ;;
    --source)
      if test "$#" -lt 2; then bad_options; fi
      take_source "$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --output)
      if test "$#" -lt 2; then bad_options; fi
      take_output "$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --count) count=yes; shift ;;
    --)
      shift
      if test "$#" -ne 0; then bad_options; fi
      ;;

  esac
done

  printf 'Invalid files\n' >&2

  total=0
  while IFS= read -r line || test -n "$line"; do total=$((total+1)); done < "$source"
  printf 'Source:%s\nMode:count\nLines:%s\n' "$source" "$total" > "$output"
else
  cat -- "$source" >> "$output"
fi
printf 'Published:%s\n' "$output"
exit 0
